entry.name: hideClockWhenIdle
entry.label: Hide clock when prompt is hidden.

entry.name: showMediaControls
entry.label: If true, shows any currently playing media along with controls to pause it.

entry.name: showNotifications
entry.label: Show a card for each application that sent notifications while the screen is locked.

entry.name: showNotificationSummaries
entry.label: Show the title of the newest notification on each card. Notification text is never shown.
